_comment: Studio's vetted instrument catalog, read by server/library-store.js. Each entry is one file with pinned sha256, bytes and size; the download route verifies the bytes against them before anything is stored. Optional extras exist only as SFZ upstream, so they wait for SFZ support (ruled 2026-11-05) and are not listed here.
